data.title: The visit ended. Compliance didn't.
data.body: Home health still owes HIPAA evidence, an SRA, and OASIS the nurse cannot finish in the driveway.

data.title: Scribes stop at the note
data.body: Ambient tools write clinical text and walk away. The audit pack is still a folder and a consultant.

data.title: Two spines, one system
data.body: Compliance OS holds the program. Ambient captures the visit. They meet in the evidence spine — not two products taped together.

data.title: Evidence lands in one place
data.body: Upload or scheduled Drive / OneDrive / Dropbox sync. Tag, classify, map to controls. Audit log is automatic.

data.title: SRA, policies, tasks
data.body: Run the risk assessment. Draft and approve policies. Gaps become tasks. AI may suggest; a human approves.

data.title: One audit pack
data.body: ZIP for the auditor: summary PDF plus a manifest of evidence and policies. Not a week of screenshots.

data.title: Consent before the recorder
data.body: Visit state decides one-party vs two-party. No consent record, no audio. Patient can withdraw; capture stops.

data.title: Record, encrypt, transcribe
data.body: Audio is encrypted on device before upload. ASR + diarization. This is capture, not the medical record yet.

data.title: Clinician attests OASIS drafts
data.body: AI maps transcript to OASIS fields. A licensed clinician reviews, edits, and attests. Nothing enters the record unsigned.

data.title: The visit becomes evidence
data.body: The attested artifact flows into the same compliance spine as policies and SRAs. Ambient is not a sidecar scribe.
